overall.summary: OIS (Oil States International) generally maintains robust and detailed disclosure across its SEC filings. The majority of flagged items were either routine editorial changes, cross-references to the annual report consistent with 10-Q conventions, or peer comparison flags where OIS was actually the more transparent discloser. The only genuine concern is the removal of specific dollar amounts related to foreign currency exchange losses and accumulated other comprehensive loss balances.
